lessons.expressionTask: Maya talks to Daniel about good leaders. What does a good leader do?

context: Maya talks to Daniel about what makes a good leader.
A good leader leads by example. She sets a good example for her team every day.
dialogue: Maya: Daniel, what makes a good leader?
Daniel: A good leader leads by example. She works hard every day.
Maya: Yes. She also sets a good example for the team.
Daniel: True. A leader with a clear vision helps the team grow.
Priya: And good leadership means you back someone up when they need help.
Maya: Exactly. A good leader supports the whole team.
lessons.listening: On Monday, Maya talks to Daniel about good leaders. She says, 'A good leader leads by example. She sets a good example for her team every day.' Daniel asks, 'What is leadership?' Maya says, 'Leadership is the skill of guiding a group. A leader needs a clear vision.' Priya says, 'Good leaders back someone up when they need help.' Daniel is happy.
lessons.question: What does Maya say a good leader does?
lessons.correct: Leads by example and sets a good example
lessons.reading: On Monday, Maya talks to Daniel about what makes a good leader. She says, 'Leadership is the skill of guiding a group of people. A good leader leads by example. A good leader must set a good example for her team every day. A leader also needs a clear vision. The new manager has a clear vision for the shop.' Priya says, 'Good leadership means you back someone up when they need help. A good leader listens to the team and helps people grow.' Maya says, 'Yes. A leader who leads by example earns the trust of the team. She must set a good example in small things too.' Daniel says, 'I want to be a good leader one day. I will learn from Maya and Priya. I will lead by example and back someone up when they need help.' Maya is happy. She says, 'Good. Start now, and learn every day.'
lessons.readingQ: What does Maya tell Daniel to do?
lessons.readingA: Start now, and learn every day.
lessons.speaking: Tell a friend about a good leader you know. What does the leader do? Why do you like the leader?
lessons.speakingSample: I want to tell you about a good leader. Maya is a good leader. She leads by example and sets a good example for her team every day. Her leadership is clear. She has a clear vision for the shop. She listens to the team and backs someone up when they need help. I want to learn from her. I will work hard and lead by example too.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend. Tell them about a good leader you know. Say what the leader does and why the team likes the leader.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Tom, I want to tell you about a good leader. Maya is a good leader at Carter Retail Group. She leads by example and sets a good example for her team every day. Her leadership is clear. She has a clear vision for the shop. She listens to the team and backs someone up when they need help. I want to learn from her. I will work hard and lead by example too. Please tell me about a good leader you know. Best, Daniel
lessons.sound: Leadership has its strongest beat on LEAD. In leadership, say LEAD clearly at the start. In vision, say VI clearly at the start.
lessons.model: Good leadership makes a team strong.
lessons.wordSample: It is the skill of guiding a group of people.

context: Daniel gives clear instructions to the team.

Maya: First, set clear goals at the start.
Daniel: Good. Then I will delegate tasks to the right people.
Maya: Yes. You have the authority to decide who does what.
Priya: And give clear guidance. New workers need clear guidance.
Daniel: Thank you. I will set clear goals and delegate tasks well.
lessons.listening: On Wednesday, Daniel gives clear instructions to the team. Maya says, 'First, set clear goals at the start of the work. Then delegate tasks to the right people.' Daniel says, 'I have the authority to decide who does what.' Priya says, 'Yes. Give clear guidance. New workers need clear guidance.' Daniel is happy. He says, 'Thank you, Maya. I will do my best.'
lessons.question: What does Maya tell Daniel to do first?
lessons.reading: On Wednesday, Daniel gives clear instructions to the team at Carter Retail Group. Maya says, 'First, set clear goals at the start of the work. Then delegate tasks to the right people. A good manager knows how to delegate.' Daniel says, 'I have the authority to decide who does what. She said she had met the manager the day before, and he gave her clear guidance.' Priya says, 'Yes. New workers need clear guidance. Give them help and tell them the plan.' Daniel says, 'I will set clear goals for the team. I will delegate tasks to Priya and Maya. I have the authority to decide, but I will listen to the team.' Maya says, 'Good. Clear guidance helps everyone. Set clear goals, delegate tasks to the right people, and tell the team what to do.' Daniel is happy. He says, 'Thank you, Maya. I will give clear instructions every day.'
lessons.readingQ: What does Daniel say he will do?
lessons.readingA: Set clear goals, and delegate tasks to Priya and Maya.

I will delegate tasks to the right people and give clear guidance every day.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend. Tell them about giving clear instructions at work. Say what you did and why it helped.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Tom, I want to tell you about giving clear instructions. On Wednesday, Daniel gave clear instructions to the team. He said, 'First, set clear goals.
